title: Arc Microgrants
description: Twenty microgrants of 500 USDC each, from a 10,000 USDC pool, for proofs of concept, tiny apps, demos, prototypes, and technical experiments already deployed and working on Arc mainnet. Build first, then submit: one submission, one link. Reviewed on a rolling basis; all decisions by October 21, 2026.
reward: 500 USDC per microgrant (20 microgrants, 10,000 USDC pool)
summary: 500 USDC × 20 grants · closes Oct 14, 11:59 PM ET
ideas: A small working demo already live on Arc
A tiny app solving one real problem
A prototype testing an Arc-native use case
setup: send about $1 of USDC on Arc to a deploy wallet
a host for a live link
your public GitHub, X, or Farcaster profile
rules: The project must be deployed and working on Arc mainnet at the time you submit.
Not eligible: design mockups, slide decks, testnet-only builds, projects with no Arc component, and work already funded by a Circle or Arc program.
One submission per project. Teams can submit more than one distinct project.
The work must be yours, or you must have the right to submit it.
Open to individuals and teams worldwide, subject to sanctions and restricted-jurisdiction screening.
Pseudonymous builders can submit. Verification happens only after conditional selection, and only for whoever receives the microgrant.
Microgrants are paid in USDC on Arc. You need a wallet that can receive USDC on Arc.
Arc uses USDC to pay gas, so you need a small amount of USDC on Arc to deploy and transact.
You keep full ownership of your work. No equity, no IP assignment, no exclusivity.
Judged on relevance to Arc, technical credibility, the quality of what you built, and whether the project is worth taking further.
